params.prompt: Photorealistic restaurant menu food photograph, 3/4 angle from slightly above. A Mexican torta on a toasted bolillo roll, cut in half and half-wrapped in foil to show the filling: grilled carne asada with a crispy layer of griddled burnt cheese, refried beans, lettuce, tomato, onion, cilantro, guacamole and orange chipotle aioli. The food sits on the red-painted wooden counter of a walk-up food stand in Los Angeles. Bright natural afternoon sunlight with crisp soft shadows, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field; background softly blurred warm red and brick tones with a hint of colorful cut-paper banners. Tack-sharp focus, true-to-life textures and natural color, appetizing, real street-food look, not over-styled. No text, no logos, no labels, no people, no hands.
